notes: Variant WLC.2SA.24.18.v003 resolved to r00-base; s022 aligned on that projection (rule 9).
בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא is written bare in English, so the preposition is unrepresented (rule 40) and the demonstrative pronoun takes the single determiner that, both articles being unrepresented (rule 41).
גֹּרֶן takes a supplied the here because the rectum is an anarthrous proper name (rule 29), which is why this verse differs from the article-bearing phrase of 2SA.24.16.
